items.title: Dell, HP and HPE Shares Rise After Lenovo Delivers Strong Quarterly Growth
items.summary: Dell Technologies (NYSE:DELL), HP Inc. (NYSE:HPQ) and Hewlett Packard Enterprise (NYSE:HPE) shares moved sharply higher in Thursday premarket trading after strong quarterly results from Lenovo (USOTC:LNVGY) boosted sentiment across the computer hardware and enterprise technology sector.

items.title: 1 Mid-Cap Stock to Consider Right Now and 2 We Ignore
items.summary: Mid-cap stocks have the best odds of scaling into $100 billion corporations thanks to their tested business models and large addressable markets.
